purpose: Preserve what was observed, hypothesized, predicted, executed, falsified, retained and prohibited from reuse so later threads do not repeat closed research or overlook useful partial findings.

entries.origin_analysis: A broad shock-conditioned admission rule advanced from 2024 H1 because entries inside the frozen SC70/C240 context appeared to contain avoidable losses.
entries.causal_hypothesis: Blocking B02/F05 entries in the exact SC70/C240 shock context would remove degraded opportunities more reliably than profitable continuation trades.
entries.decision: Exact specification closed after H2. The 2025 reconstruction is prior evidence only.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: Broad shock blocking generalizes as a net-positive portfolio filter
Loss removal dominates sacrificed continuation profit
B02 and F05 should share this scope
retained_findings: Shock-conditioned filtering removes real losses and can reduce drawdown
Failure was excessive winner sacrifice and scope breadth rather than implementation drift
prohibited_reuse: Do not retune from H2 or 2025
Do not call the 2025 reconstruction a direct candidate MT4 run
Do not propose another broad shock block without a new causal distinction
successor_questions: Can a narrower F05-only observable separate degraded post-shock entries from continuation winners?

Do not call 2025 loss compression validation
